claims.claim: Mark Rutte said Nato will defend against threats in space after German reports that Russia is preparing to launch a nuclear-armed satellite.
claims.episode_span: Mark Rutte said the alliance will defend against threats in space
claims.source_title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
claims.supporting_quote: Nato chief Mark Rutte has said the alliance will defend against any threats in space after German reports that Russia is preparing to launch a nuclear-armed satellite.

claims.claim: German media, citing anonymous military and intelligence sources, said a satellite dubbed Sputnik-S was equipped with a nuclear warhead.
claims.episode_span: a satellite dubbed Sputnik-S was equipped with a nuclear warhead
claims.source_title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
claims.supporting_quote: Citing anonymous German military and intelligence sources, public broadcasters NDR and WDR and newspaper Süddeutscher Zeitung, said the Russian satellite was dubbed "Sputnik-S" and was equipped with a nuclear warhead.

claims.claim: Intelligence reports of a possible launch in the next 60 days had been shared among Nato countries this month.
claims.episode_span: a launch in the next sixty days had been shared among Nato countries this month
claims.source_title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
claims.supporting_quote: Intelligence reports about a possible launch in the next 60 days had been shared among Nato countries this month, according to German media.

claims.claim: France 24 said German reports cited unnamed military and BND sources on a possible nuclear-armed satellite launch in coming weeks.
claims.episode_span: cited unnamed German military and BND sources
claims.source_title: Is Russia preparing to launch a nuclear-armed satellite?
claims.supporting_quote: German media reports, citing unnamed German military and BND spy agency sources, have claimed that Russia may be preparing to launch a nuclear-armed satellite in the coming weeks, giving it the capability to destroy other satellites.

claims.claim: Bleddyn Bowen said a nuclear explosion in space would affect more than 15,000 active satellites and would also damage Russian space infrastructure.
claims.episode_span: massive effects on more than 15,000 active satellites
claims.source_title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
claims.supporting_quote: Bleddyn Bowen, co-director of the Space Research Centre at Durham University, said that exploding a nuclear weapon in space would have "massive infrastructural effects" as there were now more than 15,000 active satellites.

claims.claim: Gaza health officials said at least seven Palestinians, including a child and police officers, were killed in Israeli air strikes.
claims.episode_span: at least seven Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes, including a child and police officers
claims.source_title: Israeli air strikes in Gaza kill 7 as doctors warn of meningitis outbreak
claims.supporting_quote: At least seven Palestinians, including a child and police officers, have been killed and dozens injured in Israeli air strikes on the Gaza Strip.

claims.claim: Dr Nidal Ghoneim said meningitis cases in Gaza rose to 272 in October, more than eight times a typical monthly rate of 30 to 50.
claims.episode_span: cases rose to 272 in October, more than eight times a typical month of 30 to 50
claims.source_title: Israeli air strikes in Gaza kill 7 as doctors warn of meningitis outbreak
claims.supporting_quote: Dr Nidal Ghoneim, deputy director general of primary care for public health affairs, said at a news conference that cases of meningitis rose to 272 in October, more than eight times the normal monthly rate, which ranges from 30 to 50 cases.

claims.claim: Ghoneim said 15 meningitis deaths have been recorded in Gaza since the start of this year, and bacterial meningitis cases reached 108 in October.
claims.episode_span: 15 people have died of the disease since the start of this year
claims.source_title: Israeli air strikes in Gaza kill 7 as doctors warn of meningitis outbreak
claims.supporting_quote: Ghoneim explained that 15 deaths resulting from the disease have been recorded since the start of this year, including five deaths in August, September and October.
